## New in this release

### New
- **Add to calendar** (Android and iOS): in the export sheet, choose *Calendar (.ics)* and tap *Add to calendar*. For regular lessons, substitutions, exams and cancelled lessons you pick a new calendar (coloured like your timetable settings), one of your own calendars, or *Don't add*. The next 2–12 weeks are added and kept up to date whenever you open the app: substitutions, room changes and cancellations update the events, removed lessons disappear. Manage or stop syncs under *Calendar sync* in the menu. The app asks for calendar access the first time. *Download .ics* is still there for a one-off file.
- Export to your calendar: the export sheet now offers **Calendar (.ics)**. A specific week becomes one event per lesson (cancelled lessons are marked as cancelled, holidays are all-day events). The regular timetable becomes weekly repeating events until the end of the school year, with holidays left out. Import the file into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook and others.

### Improved
- The export button is now always visible in the timetable's top bar instead of hidden in the ⋮ menu.

### Fixed
- "Browse timetables": the Classes / Teachers / Rooms tabs are centered again (#2).
- Add to calendar: new calendars are grouped under "BetterBetterUntis" and checked after creating; the setup screen explains where to turn them on in Google Calendar.
- Add to calendar: your own calendars inside a Google account (e.g. "Family", "School") are listed too, also when they are turned off in the calendar app; sorted by account.
- Add to calendar (Android): a note explains that new calendars only exist on the phone, how to create synced calendars in Google Calendar on the web (button), how to turn on sync and that colours of Google calendars are set in Google Calendar. The list refreshes when you come back to the app.
- Add to calendar (Android): the app asks your accounts to sync their calendars and has a refresh button, so calendars just created on the web show up sooner.
- Calendar sync (Android): new button to delete calendars that only exist on this phone (they can't be deleted in Google Calendar). Syncs using them stop adding to them.
